summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting a repurchase of 12.2M shares across 16 trading sessions (March 20 – April 13, 2026) for cancellation, with prices ranging ~$6.57–$6.82 per share (median ~$6.70). A nominal issue of 2,000 shares at $5.33 occurred from option exercises. The buyback reduces share count by ~1.45% and signals management's view of undervaluation. As a foreign private issuer, the filing corresponds to a US share repurchase disclosure. Watch for future buyback pace or any intended increase; no premium or advisor named.
